## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a75f9f22585f8c1274e9f5acf317b77a01017c65`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #23006 (body and all three comments: triage 6123056260, the dispatch `Claim:` 6123468051, the os-dev-report 6123800633); PR #23037 (body, file list, the three-dot diff against `main`; the head's parent is `edecd4485`); the check-runs on the head, read three times (the last at 2026-10-12T12:07:57Z). Every factual claim the diff adds about code was read against `origin/main` at `0ede0f8ab3` with `git show` / `git grep`. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set and public surface: none changed — right.** The diff touches `docs/adr/0005-metadata-customization-overlay.md` (+19/−9, 898 → 908 lines) and the `invariant` string of two `scripts/adr-anchors/*.json` files (one span each). No `packages/**` path, no schema, no runtime code, no SQL, no generated artifact. The anchor files are read only by `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs`, which audits the `ADR-NNNN Dk` citations inside an `invariant`; neither edited string changes a citation. Both anchor base blobs (`de4e27e13a4`, `797dfd110fb`) are the blobs at `origin/main`, so the one-span edits are against the current text.

Factual claims the diff adds, each read against source — all right:

| Claim added by the diff | Source on `origin/main` | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| The declared index is `{ name: 'idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active', fields: ['type', 'name', 'organization_id', 'package_id', 'bundle_member'], unique: 'global' }` at `sys-metadata.object.ts:250-254` | `packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata.object.ts:250-254` reads exactly that | right |
| Runtime key `(type, name, organization_id, COALESCE(package_id, ''), COALESCE(bundle_member, ''))` `WHERE state = 'active'`, with the `_draft` sibling | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/overlay-index.ts`: `OVERLAY_INDEX_COLUMNS` (:169) names the five columns; `OVERLAY_NULL_SENTINELS` (:190) folds `package_id` and `bundle_member` to `''`; `overlayIndexKeyParts()` plus `buildOverlayIndexSql()` (:210) emit `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX … WHERE state = '…'` per state; the names `idx_sys_metadata_overlay_active` / `_draft` are at :151-152 | right |
| `bundle_member` is a bundled type's member (an `email_template`'s locale); two members of one item are two rows; NULL is the canonical member and every row of a name-only type; folded to `''`, those rows are constrained exactly as under the four-part key | `overlay-index.ts` module header :95-105 (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`, today `email_template`'s `(name, locale)`; "NULL is the canonical member and every row of an undiscriminated type, folded to the `''` bucket so those rows are constrained exactly as before"); `sys-metadata.object.ts:227-229` says the same | right |
| In force since `5677add93f` (PR #22954, #22877 ruling A) | `5677add93f` is an ancestor of `origin/main`, subject "fix(metadata-protocol): two locales of one email template survive a restart — … (#22877, stage 1) (#22954)", 2026-10-12 09:01Z; its diff adds `bundle_member` to both files above. The card body itself names ruling 6116165299, letter A | right |
| `'global'` is protocol 18's spelling of the bare `true` it retired (ADR-0120 D2) | ADR-0120 D1 (bare `true` on a declared index: 17.x warn → protocol 18 reject) and D2 (the ADR-0087 entry rewrites `unique: true → 'global'`); `ef1fcb26a` (#22103, 2026-10-08) made exactly that one-token edit in `sys-metadata.object.ts` | right |
| The declared (coarse) index is NULL-distinct on `package_id` and on `bundle_member`, so it holds no canonical row unique | Derived, and it follows: a plain `UNIQUE` over five bare columns, `bundle_member` NULL on every canonical and undiscriminated row, SQL UNIQUE treating NULLs as distinct — the premise the ADR already carried, and `overlay-index.ts:184-186` restates it for this very column ("a bare part would leave exactly the rows this index has always constrained unconstrained"). The old sentence "it still prevents duplicate active overlays" was false after `5677add93f`; the restatement is a correction, not a widening | right |
| The #6771 measurement sentence (`:835`) is kept verbatim and gains a dated note | It records a measurement of its day; the note points at the status line and the two owners, and the section it names ("What delivers overlay uniqueness today — exactly two owners") exists at `:861` | right |

Site coverage: at the head's parent `edecd4485`, ADR-0005 carries three present-tense four-part sites — `:835` (measurement, kept), `:867` (Owner 1), `:878` (Owner 2 quotation, with `unique: true`). The card named two (`:833`, `:865` at `5677add93f`; the +2 is PR #23011's top note), and its re-check grep could not match `:878`'s quoted form. The dev's full re-grep is the right reading. `:570` (`unique: true` in the Addendum (d) YAML) is a dated historical block and is rightly left standing.

Line citations into ADR-0005: all eight on `origin/main` (`metadata-plugin.zod.ts:896` and `:938`, its anchor JSON, three tests, `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors.mjs:611` and `:619`) point at `:53-64` or `:57`. The status entry replaces line 8 one-for-one and the body hunks start at `:838`, so every cited range is byte-identical; the dev's H4 check on one anchor generalises to all eight.

Check-runs on the head (their conclusions are the gate verdicts): `Lint & Repo Gates` success (the job that carries `check:adr-anchors` and `check-adr-links`); `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; `Check Changeset` success; `Check PR Size` success; `Check Documentation Links` — the first run (`114799118871`) failed in the lychee binary download before any link was checked, the re-run (`114801046985`) is success and is the latest conclusion; `Test Core` shards 1/6 through 6/6 all success; `Type Check · source gates`, `· consumer gates`, `· debt ledger` success; every `Lint ·` shard success; `Type Check · workspace` (`114799118670`) was still in_progress at my 12:05:12Z read and is success at my last read (2026-10-12T12:07:57Z), when the `TypeScript Type Check` (`114802989657`) and `Test Core` (`114802466655`) aggregate contexts had also been emitted, both success; `Build Core`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Build Docs`, the dogfood matrix and the tarball smoke are `skipped` by the path filter (docs-only diff), and the `Dogfood Regression Gate` aggregate is success. At the last read every one of the 43 check-runs is completed with conclusion success or skipped; nothing is red and nothing is in progress.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: no released package is in the diff (`docs/adr/**` and repo-root `scripts/adr-anchors/**` publish nothing), so there is nothing a changeset could describe, and `Check Changeset` passed on the label. The PR body carries `Clause-②: no` as its second line — right: no accept-set widens or narrows, no public surface moves, no author-writable key changes. No ADR-0087 disposition is owed, since nothing is breaking.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: empty — nothing to answer.

Dev deviations (four), each judged:
1. Owner 2's trailing sentence restated beyond "five fields plus the corrected `unique` value" — **accepted**: it is a present-tense statement of the current key's effect, inside the claim's file surface, and the old sentence was false after `5677add93f` (table row 6 above). The PR body flags it as the one sentence for the maintainer to read closely; that is the right handling for Tier H text.
2. The `'global'` parenthetical — **accepted**, verified against ADR-0120 D1/D2 and `ef1fcb26a`.
3. Commit trailers in the model-free pair (`Claude-Session:` plus `Co-authored-by: Claude`), not the harness's model-named form — **accepted**: read on the head commit; it is AGENTS.md's form, and no model identifier appears in the title, body, commit or label set.
4. PR body footer in the session-URL form — **accepted**: AGENTS.md's form for PR bodies; the body read back intact, the Chinese 维护者速读 block included.

The two anchor edits: the dispatch's `Claim:` (6123468051) named both anchor files conditionally — the key spelling in their `invariant` only, if measured stale. Both were stale (the base blobs spell four parts), each edit is one span, and the citations inside the strings are unchanged. I could not find the phrase "bounded in-place rule" in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` or the pm-dispatch skill at `origin/main`; the dispatch's own conditional authorisation and the measured staleness decide it, so this is a note, not a flag. One residual: the `sys-metadata.object.ts.json` invariant still says knex "can express neither `WHERE state = 'active'` nor `COALESCE(package_id, '')`" without naming `COALESCE(bundle_member, '')` — true as written, incomplete rather than false, and outside a one-span edit; not a defect.

Out-of-scope findings (five), **escalated to the seat, none a FAIL reason** — every one is outside the claim's file surface and the dev reported it rather than expanding scope:
- (a) `docs/adr/0029-kernel-object-ownership-and-platform-objects-decomposition.md:669` and `docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md:313` still spell the four-part key — verified on `origin/main`. Same class (b), same producer; the dev's "one family closure card" is the right shape, and the seat files it (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H).
- (b) `skills/objectstack-data/rules/indexing.md:165` (published skill, Tier H) quotes the four-part runtime SQL — verified; rides the family card.
- (c) `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json:1125` recreates the declared form with four columns — verified; drift only, rides the family card.
- (d) `packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata.object.ts:246-249` still says the declared index "still prevents duplicate ACTIVE overlays" — verified; once this PR lands, that code comment contradicts ADR-0005's Owner 2 sentence. A one-line comment fix in a non-governed file; the seat should carry it on or beside the family card so the record and the code comment do not disagree.
- (e) `organization_id` bare and NULL-distinct on both tiers — pre-existing, and `overlay-index.ts:117-118` already names it as its own ADR-0120 D4 ceremony. Noted, no action.

Tier: `docs/adr/**` is the `adr` row of `GOVERNED_SURFACES`, Tier H. This record is the contract-tier review of record for this head; it does **not** lift Tier H — landing waits for an authorized APPROVED review from a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account, after which the owning seat lands it. The PR is draft, auto-merge is not armed, and the head repo equals the base repo (not a fork). Nothing in this record is a reason to ready, queue or arm it.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读(终稿)

PR #23037 · card #23006 · head `a75f9f2258` · seat `domain:skills#2` (`session_012dGTuJen61ECNHXYXKChoC`), written 2026-10-12T12:10Z. The seat checked the dev's draft against the diff it read; this comment is the version to read.

**改了什么**
- ADR-0005 状态行末尾加一条 2026-10-12 修订:#22877 裁决 A 让 overlay 唯一键多了第五段 `bundle_member`。
- 「今天由谁保证 overlay 唯一」一节:运行时索引改成五段键;声明索引的引文改成代码原文(五个字段,`unique: 'global'`)。
- #6771 当年的实测原句不动,后面加一条带日期的注记。
- 两份 ADR 锚点 JSON 只把键的写法改成五段,其余一字未动。

**为什么改**
- 自 `5677add93f`(PR #22954)起,同一封邮件模板的不同语言版本在 overlay 里各存一行。区分它们的就是第五段 `bundle_member`。
- ADR 还写着四段键,照 ADR 理解唯一性的 agent 和作者会被带偏。
- 新增一句结论:声明的兜底索引对 `bundle_member` 是 NULL-distinct,而规范成员(绝大多数行)这一列是 NULL,所以只靠兜底索引的栈不再约束任何规范成员行。席位核过代码:`'global'` 就是旧的裸 `true`,按 ADR-0120 D2 字节等同转换,按列原样建普通 UNIQUE。dev 在 SQLite 上实测过。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**
- 只改文档和锚点文字:不发布任何包,不改运行时行为,`skip-changeset`。
- ADR-0005 净增 10 行(898 → 908)。
- 回滚:revert 本 PR 的单个提交即可。
- 同样的四段写法还留在 ADR-0029、ADR-0126 和已发布的 `objectstack-data` 技能 `rules/indexing.md` 里,席位已立收口卡 #23039 统一跟进,不在本 PR 内。

**席位意见**
- 建议批准。
- 三处现在时陈述逐一对过 `origin/main` 代码原文:`OVERLAY_INDEX_COLUMNS` / `overlayIndexKeyParts`,以及 `sys-metadata.object.ts` 的声明索引。
- 另一份锚点按行号区间(53–64)引用 ADR-0005,这段没有挪动。
- 契约复核:达档 PASS,记录为本 PR 评论 6123969188(同 head `a75f9f2258`);CI 43 项全部完成(success 或按路径 skipped)。

**你要做的**
- 同意:在 PR #23037 上给一个 APPROVED 评审,之后由席位翻 ready 并入队落地。
- 不同意:在 PR 上留言,指出要改的那一句。
